[[XL Center]] |champion= |bowl=[[2010 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |bowl_result=Second Round }} {{2009–10 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2009–10 Connecticut Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Connecticut]] in the 2009–2010 [[NCAA Division I]] basketball season. The Huskies were coached by [[Jim Calhoun]] and played their home games at the [[XL Center]] in [[Hartford, Connecticut]], and on campus at the [[Harry A. Gampel Pavilion]] in [[Storrs, Connecticut]]. The Huskies are a member of the [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 18–16, 7–11 in Big East play and lost in the first round of the [[2010 Big East men's basketball tournament]]. UConn was invited to the [[2010 National Invitation Tournament]] and advanced to the second round before losing to [[2009–10 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]] 65–63. ==Preseason== Senior [[Jerome Dyson]] and sophomore [[Kemba Walker]] were named to the All-BIG EAST Preseason Team while senior [[Stanley Robinson (basketball)|Stanley Robinson]] garnered All-BIG EAST Honorable Mention accolades. ===Roster changes=== UConn was hit hard due to the graduation of starters [[Jeff Adrien]], [[A. J. Price]], and [[Craig Austrie]].
